aRegistrationCanBeReusedAcross: A registration can be reused across workspaces, or you can keep work and personal Apps separate. Each workspace selects and installs its own credential.
aSeparatePersonalIdentityIsOnly: A separate personal identity is only needed when workspace automation uses a GitHub App.
allRepositoriesAllowedByThisWorkspace: All repositories allowed by this workspace
allowsInstallationElsewhereItDoesNot: Allows installation elsewhere. It does not publish to Marketplace or grant repos.
anExecutorProfileGhTokenOr: An executor-profile GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN overrides managed workspace credentials for that task.
anImportedAppMustHaveAt: An imported App must have at least these repository permissions and subscribed events.
autoFixHasUsedOfRounds: Auto-fix has used {{current}} of {{max}} rounds for this PR. A round is counted when Kandev sends or queues a CI auto-fix message. Kandev waits for all PR checks to finish before starting a new CI auto-fix turn, so the agent gets the final failed checks and current comments together. Updating an already queued auto-fix message does not use another round. When this is at {{max}}/{{max}} and there is no pending auto-fix message left to update, Kandev pauses auto-fix for this PR so it cannot loop forever. Disable and re-enable auto-fix after manual review to start over.
automaticallyCreateTasksWhenNewGithub: Automatically create tasks when new GitHub issues match your criteria.
automaticallyCreateTasksWhenNewPull: Automatically create tasks when new pull requests need your review.
bestForPersonalOrCompanyInternal: Best for personal or company-internal automation.
chooseTheAutomationAndPersonalIdentities: Choose the automation and personal identities used by this workspace.
chooseTheExactAccountKandevDoes: Choose the exact account. Kandev does not silently follow the CLI's active-account change.
configureTheExistingAppOnGithub: Configure the existing App on GitHub
couldNotLoadGithubCliAccounts: Could not load GitHub CLI accounts. {{loadError}}
customQueryPressEnterEG: Custom query — press Enter. e.g. "is:open review-requested:@me"
editAutoFixPromptForThis: Edit auto-fix prompt for this task
githubApiRateLimitExhaustedOn: GitHub API rate limit exhausted on {{value2}}. Background PR/issue checks are paused until the limit resets {{value4}}.
githubIsReadyToCreateThe: GitHub is ready to create the App
githubMustReachThisHttpsOrigin: GitHub must reach this HTTPS origin for signed webhooks and callbacks.
githubSearchQuerySupportsFullGithub: GitHub search query. Supports full GitHub search syntax for maximum flexibility.
githubSearchQueryWhenSetOverrides: GitHub search query. When set, overrides the label filter above.
githubWillShowTheGeneratedPermissions: GitHub will show the generated permissions and ask you to confirm. Returning from GitHub adds the registration; installing it for this workspace remains an explicit step.
howOftenToCheckForNew: How often to check for new issues. Minimum 60s, maximum 3600s.
howOftenToCheckForNew2: How often to check for new PRs. Minimum 60s, maximum 3600s.
kandevBrokersTheWorkspacePatNamed: Kandev brokers the workspace PAT, named GitHub CLI account, or App identity to this task for GitHub HTTPS and gh.
kandevFirstReservesExactCallbackAnd: Kandev first reserves exact callback and webhook URLs, then guides you through GitHub's App settings. Existing workspace access is unchanged until you install the imported App.
kandevGeneratesTheExactAppPolicy: Kandev generates the exact App policy. You confirm creation on GitHub; Kandev then stores this registration so it can be selected by a workspace.
kandevStoresThisTokenForThis: Kandev stores this token for this workspace. GitHub records actions as the token owner.
label: Label
localAndWorktreeTasksUseHost: Local and Worktree tasks use host-visible Git or SSH credentials. Docker, SSH, and cloud tasks use credentials configured in that executor.
name: Name
noGithubAppsAreRegisteredYet: No GitHub Apps are registered yet. Add an existing App or create one below.
noIssueWatchesConfiguredCreateOne: No issue watches configured. Create one to start monitoring GitHub issues.
noPullRequestLinkedToThis: No pull request linked to this session.
noPullRequestsMatchThisFilter: No pull requests match this filter.
noReviewWatchesConfiguredCreateOne: No review watches configured. Create one to start monitoring PRs.
noWorkspaceConfiguredCreateAWorkspace: No workspace configured. Create a workspace first to start tasks from PRs/issues.
omitThePlaceholderIfYouWant: Omit the placeholder if you want the agent to pull or fetch the branch and inspect GitHub itself instead of receiving Kandev's snapshot.
onlyMatchIssuesWithTheseLabels: Only match issues with these labels. Leave empty for all issues.
onlyPrsWhereYouAreExplicitly: Only PRs where you are explicitly requested as a reviewer (not via team membership)
optionalFallsBackToStepDefault: Optional — falls back to step default. The executor environment where the agent will run.
permissionsAvailableToKandevThroughThis: Permissions available to Kandev through this workspace's GitHub App installation.
prsWhereYouOrAnyOf: PRs where you or any of your teams are requested as reviewers
pullRequestCiStatusReviewsAnd: Pull request CI status, reviews, and checks summary.
pullRequestsLinkedToThisTask: {{length}} pull requests linked to this task — open one
saveThisQueryToTheSidebar: Save this {{value1}} query to the sidebar for quick access later.
signInWithThenReopenThis: Sign in with <1>{{value0}}</1>, then reopen this dialog.
thePlaceholderInsertsTheCurrentPr: The placeholder inserts the current PR identifier, new or changed failing checks with GitHub job links, and new or changed review comments with file, line, and body text.
thePromptSentToTheAgent: The prompt sent to the agent for each new issue. Type {{ to insert placeholders.
thePromptSentToTheAgent2: The prompt sent to the agent for each new PR. Type {{ to insert placeholders, or @ to reference a saved prompt by name — it expands the same way it does in workflow step prompts, since this prompt becomes the task description passed through that same assembly.
theWorkflowStepPromptWrapsThis: The workflow step prompt wraps this prompt. For example, if the step prompt is <2>Analyze the task: {{task_prompt}}</2> , the final prompt becomes <5>Analyze the task: Pull Request ready for review: https://...</5>
thisAccountAlsoPowersMyGithub: This account also powers My GitHub and user-triggered actions.
thisAppRegistrationIsSharedBy: This App registration is shared by {{workspace_binding_count}} workspaces. Registration changes affect every workspace using it; installation access remains workspace-specific.
thisBranchCanTBeMerged: This branch can't be merged automatically. Resolve the conflicts before merging.
thisPromptIsUsedOnlyFor: This prompt is used only for this task. Leave it blank to use the default prompt. Add <2>{{PR_FEEDBACK_PLACEHOLDER}}</2> when you want Kandev to include its PR feedback snapshot.
thisRepositoryOpensByDefaultYou: This repository opens by default. You can change the filter after opening the query.
toSeeYourPullRequestsAnd: {{value0}} <2>{{value0}}</2> to see your pull requests and issues.
typeAndAreSubstitutedWhenThe: Type {{ to see available placeholders. <4>{{url}}</4> and <7>{{title}}</7> are substituted when the action runs.
useAnAppWhenAutomationNeeds: Use an App when automation needs its own identity, short-lived tokens, and repository-level installation control. Setup is more involved and requires a publicly reachable HTTPS URL.
usedByWorkspacesEditingOrDeleting: <0></0> Used by {{workspace_binding_count}} workspaces. Editing or deleting it affects all of them.
watchesThisTaskSLinkedPull: Watches this task's linked pull request during the 1 minute PR refresh loop. Auto-fix queues a task prompt for new failed checks and unresolved review comments when the prompt includes the PR feedback placeholder, then snapshots what was handled so the next round only sends newly observed issues. Auto-merge runs only after CI, review, and mergeability are ready.
whichAllowedGithubRepositoriesToMonitor: Which allowed GitHub repositories to monitor for this watch.
